characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: A units effected by this **hex** have +1 **to hit** with **Bolter**, **Combi-Bolter** and/or **Bolt Pistol**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
A **infantry** effected by this **hex** have +1 **to hit** with **Unquie**, **Chainsword**, **Force sword**, **Power sword**, **Terranic Greatsword**, **Calibanite warblade**, **charnabal sabre**, **Paragon Blade** and any **Close combat Weapons**.




**Vehicles** have +1 to **melee weapons strength** when it charges.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Units effected by this **hex** are -1 to **wound** with **flame**,**volkite**,**plasma** and **phosphex weapons** and any **anti** keywords the **weapons** have is worsened by 1 when wounding a unit with this **hex** {eg: **[Anti-Infantry 3+]** goes to **[Anti-Infantry 4+]**}

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
When a unit **effected** by this hex targets a **vehicle** it can **re-roll hit rolls** of 1. 
**Vehicle** units also *snap-shoot** on 5+ instead of just 6s

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When a unit effected by this **hex** targets a unit with a **charecter** model in it all weapons have +1 **to wound**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
All non-**vehicle** units effected by this hex gain +1" to **advance rolls**.
**Mounted** units can re-roll any failed **[Feel No Pain X+]** against ranged attacks
**Vehicles** gain +2" to movement instead

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model and its unit can **re-roll melee hit rolls**.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: At the start of **each fight phase** each enemy **Character** unit withing 6" of this model must make a **battle-shock roll** at -1.

characteristics.name: Description

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model and its units **attacks** that target **enemy Character** units have +1 to **wound rolls**.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
In the **fight phase**, when this model is **destroyed**, if this model has not been **selected to fight** this phase, rolld 1D6:
- On a 2+: Do not remove this model from the battlefield. After this unit has fought or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first, this model is removed from the battlefeild

rules.name: Silence

characteristics.name: Description

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
In the **fight phase**, when a model in this unit is **destroyed**, if that model has not been **selected to fight** this phase, rolld 1D6:
- On a 4+: Do not remove that model from the battlefield. After it has fought or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first, it is removed from the battlefeild

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model and its unit have a **[Feel No Pain 3+]** against **psychic** and **mortal wounds**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Once per turn, when your opponent targets a unit from their army within 12” of this model with a **stratagem**, you can use this ability. If you do increase the CP cost of that use of that **stratagem** by 1CP.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Once per turn, in your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit makes a ranged attacks that targets a friendly **DARK ANGELS** unit within 3" of this model, after that enemy unit has shot, this model can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but it must target only that enemy unit when doing so and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model and its unit gain **[Lethal Hits]** on all **weapons**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Each time this model makes an attack that targets an enemy unit that is Below Half-strength, add 1 to the **Hit** and **Wound rolls**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While this model is within 3" of one or more other friendly **Dark Angels Mounted** or **Dark Angels Fly Vehicle** units, this model has the **Lone Operative** ability.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While a friendly **Dark Angels** Mounted or **Dark Angels** Fly Vehicle unit is within 6" of this model, **ranged weapons** equipped by models in that unit have the **[IGNORES COVER]** ability.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Once per turn, when an enemy unit ends a **Normal**, **Advance** or **Fall Back** move within 9" of this model, if this model is not within **Engagement Range** of one or more enemy units, this model can make a **Normal move** of up to 6".

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model and its unit gain Mobile. This model and its unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced. If that unit is already eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced, add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for that unit instead.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When an enemy unit engaged with this unit (excluding **Monster/Vehicle** units) makes a fall-back move, that enemy unit must use the desperate escape mode. If that enemy unit is battle‑shocked, ‑1 from those hazard rolls.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
(Once per turn, per unit)
In your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot, if those attacks destroyed a friendly ^^**Dark Angels**^^ unit within 6" of this unit, you can use this ability. If you do, this unit shoots using normal shooting but while doing so this unit can only target that enemy unit.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: In your Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, select one **Hexagrammation** to be active for this unit until the start of your next Command phase. (He still keeps all the **keyword** but not the **abilities**)

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
At the end of your opponent’s Fight phase, select one visible enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT/Lone Operative units) within 24" of this unit. That enemy unit is slowed until the end of your opponent’s next Movement phase:

▪ While a unit is slowed, in your opponent’s Movement phase, when that unit is selected to move, unless that unit remains stationary, roll one D6:
    ▫ On a 1-4, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds and that unit has -2" M.
    ▫ On a 5-6, that unit suffers 2D3 mortal wounds and that unit has -3" M.’

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While a friendly **Dark Angels** unit is within 6" of this unit, that unit has **Stealth**.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While this unit contains a **Deathwing Champion**, add 1 to **Advance** and **Charge rolls** made for this unit and you can target this unit with the **Heroic Intervention Stratagem** for 0CP.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While this unit contains an Ancient, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of its models.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While this unit contains an Apothecary, in your Command phase, you can return 1 destroyed model (excluding Character models) to this unit.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
- Attacks that target this unit have -1D.
- This unit cannot be targeted with the Tactical Dreadnought Fortitude stratagem.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
(Once per battle, per unit)


At the start of the battle, you can set up one Teleport Homer token for this unit on the battlefield. If you do:


- When you target this unit with the Rapid Ingress stratagem, you can use that Teleport Homer token. If you do, that use is -1 CP, but when resolving that stratagem, this unit must be set up within 3" of that Teleport Homer token and not within 8" of an enemy unit. That Teleport Homer token is then removed from the battlefield.
- If an enemy unit ends a move within 1" of that Teleport Homer token, that Teleport Homer token is removed from the battlefield.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
This unit's attacks can ignore modifiers to:
- BS and WS.
- **Hit rolls**.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: At the start of the battle, you can set up one Teleport Homer token for this unit anywhere on the battlefield that is not in your opponent’s deployment zone. If you do, once per battle, you can target this unit with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem for 0CP, but when resolving that Stratagem, you must set this unit up within 3" horizontally of that token and not within 8" horizontally of any enemy models. That token is then removed.
